Name: SVE Winery Renovation
Author: hethyin
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=3][b]SVE Winery Renovation[/b] revamps the interior of the Stardew Valley Expanded winery, providing a few visual cleanups whilst keeping the overall style in line with the original design.

[b]Features:[/b]
- [b]All furniture cleared[/b], including the barrels, boxes and pillars against the back wall.
- [b]Four wallpaper options [/b]and [b]four flooring options [/b]to customise the feel of your winery.
- Optional [b]slight expansion[/b] of the left-hand wing to neatly fit one more accessible row of casks.
- Optional [b]windows[/b] on the back wall.
- Unreachable rooms on the left-hand side removed.

[/size][/font][center][font=Tahoma][size=3]---///---[/size][/font][/center][font=Tahoma][size=3]

[b]To install:[/b]
- Make sure you have SMAPI, Content Patcher and SVE installed and working correctly.
- Download the most recent version of the mod.
- Unpack the zip file into your Mods folder.
- Done!

[b]To uninstall:[/b]
- First, I recommend removing all contents from your winery. This will prevent items becoming inaccessible if they are inside walls or furniture on the base SVE map.
- If you don't want to remove contents (eg there are casks currently processing that you don't want to interrupt), everything [i]should[/i] be accessible on the clean version of the base SVE map. Casks against the back wall or in the right-hand area may now be inside barrels/crates/pillars/etc, but should still be reachable. Likewise, if you were using the SlightlyLarger map, casks against the bottom wall in the left-hand area will now be inside the wall, but should still be reachable. If they're not, you could always use a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip[/url] to retrieve them once they're finished processing.
- Once your winery is empty, save and quit, then delete the [CP] SVE Winery Renovation folder from your Mods folder.
- Done!

[center]---///---[/center][/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=3]
[b]Config:[/b]
The config can be edited either using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]or directly by editing the config.json file in the mod folder.

Config options:
"Enable Mod": true, false [i](default: true)[/i]
﻿Enables the mod: without this ticked, the base SVE winery interior will be loaded.
"Interior Size": Default, SlightlyLarger [i](default: Default)
[/i] ﻿Controls the winery size. Default is the same size as the base SVE winery; SlightlyLarger adds one extra row of tiles on the left-hand side, to neatly line eight rows of accessible casks.
"Floor Material": WoodAndStone, Wood, Stone, Brick [i](default: WoodAndStone)
[/i] ﻿Controls the appearance of the flooring.
"Wall Material": PlainWood, WoodWithRail, Stone, Brick [i](default: PlainWood)
[/i] ﻿Controls the appearance of the walls.
"Enable Windows": true, false [i](default: true)
[/i] ﻿Adds four windows to the back wall.

[center]---///---[/center]

[b]Notes:[/b]
Example furnished winery image is using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32162]HxW Winery Furniture[/url].
This is my first mod, so there may be mistakes! If you find something wrong, please point it out and I will fix it!
Likewise, if you would like different wall/flooring/window options or other customisations, let me know and I'll see what I can do :)[/size][/font][size=3]
[/size]
